en: Ah- No! Get back!
So rude. I'm gonna help you out of there!
Wh- But why? I'm your enemy...
That's what heroes do.
The resistance?! Get away from me!
Don't be rude, I'm here to help you.
I would never accept...
...You know what? Go ahead. They don't pay me enough for this shit.
Here, I got this.
Thanks. I'm out.
Help! I'm trapped! Please help!
I've got ya! Don't worry. It's gonna be okay.
Thank you... Thank you so much!
Jenna?! Is that you? Please help!
It's me! I'm gonna get you out of here.
Oh god, thank you!
Jenna! It's good to see you, please help me!
Of course. Stay still, I'm gonna get you out.
I'm glad you found me. Thanks!
Jenna! I'm stuck!
I've got you, don't worry.
You're a life saver!
Ah, this one is Monica. She was one of my more recent girls. Never got to know her too well, but I'm definitely glad to be reunited!
They've got names too?
Of course they have names! How else am I supposed to tell them apart?
I'm guessing this one has a name too?
Yep, this one is Erica. She was my first, and you never forget your first! Oh, all the wonderful times we spent together...
Damn, you're pretty dedicated.
Ooooh, who's this one? I like her.
This one is Rita. She's a little shy with strangers but when we're alone, she's the most feisty one from the whole bunch.
Rida? Her name like mine?
Close, but not quite. She's 'Rita', spelt with a 'T'.
You're 'Rida' with a 'D'.
Heheh!
Hehehe~
Why everyone laughing?
Arnold over here! This one's stuck under some debris!
No! Tina! What have they done to her!?
If we can get her out of there, we can probably fix her up back at the camp.
Those Peitho bastards! I'll never forgive them for what they've done!
Hold on, Tina! I'll save you! Everyone, stand back!
Rrrraaaaaaaaaaaaagh!
(Damn, he's strong!)
Look! Doll okay!
Rida's right, it doesn't actually appear to be that badly harmed at all!
Oh, Tina! You're okay! I'm so relieved!
But...how? If it was caught under all that falling debris, how could it not have been broken?
Tina's a very tough gal. She looks like the rest of them, but she's actually made out of reinforced metal for when uh... things get passionate... eheh.
All's well that ends well, right?
Right! Let's pick up the rest!
It's Sandra! She's looking stunning as ever. Come here, girl!
Are you doing okay there, Arnold? Are you just gonna carry them all yourself?
Absolutely! After so long without my girls, we need some skin to skin contact! I can handle it just fine, I'm used to lifting things way heavier!
Arnold strong! Rida like that.
I'd be happy to train with you when we go back to the camp!
Here she is! Whoo boy, training just wasn't the same without you, Mary.
This one train with you?
No, but she helps in her own way!
Yes, we've found Jessica!
Oh man, all these girls. You could probably write a song about your life, Arnold.
Yep, I can definitely see a catchy mambo being written about Arnie and his girls.
You guys think so?
Now that I think about it, a song is the perfect gift I can give to my girls to show them how much I appreciate them after our unfortunate separation!
An ominous noise interrupts us... Whatever's down here with us, it's probably worse than Peitho.
It's those things again...
Hate to break the touching reunion, but I think they're onto us!
Right! Let's make our daring escape!
And that's that! We put those Peitho grunts in their place! We're not gonna let them break our spirits just 'cus they raided our base!
I won't let anyone refer to me as a test subject anymore!
And I no allow anyone to question my title again!
I knew I could count on you guys! They never stood a chance.
Next time we run into them, you can count on me to get in a few kicks on behalf of my girls too!
Alright, let's head back to the camp and help set up Arnold's room!
Whew...we made it out alive!
I am not looking forward to encountering those things again.
You never know, if worse comes to worst, I could always fuck them till they've got no stamina to chase us anymore!
This is definitely a subset of 'people', if you can even call those things that, that you should not be thinking about fucking, Jewel!
Why not? It's not like that trick's failed me before.
Everyone! Rida hear something!
We're out of the cave, Rida. I don't think those things can follow us out here. What's the worst that could happen?
You there! It's the resistance!
And the escaped test subject from the lower floors! Along with one of the fiends!
Demons...
You! You're the ones who raided our base and put my beloved girls at risk!
What? These girls here are the resistance robot's harem?
You'll have less time to wonder about stupid questions like that after we take you down, you Peitho scum!
Though I for one wouldn't mind being part of Arnie's harem.
Jewel!!!
Okay, okay! I'm ready to fight either way!
Give 'em hell guys!
You got it! We're gonna make 'em pay for what they've done.
And there we go! Now we're all set!
It took a while, but I can finally say this place feels like home again!
Always happy to help out a hunk in need!
It really is nice to see you return back to your usual self, Arnold. The resistance just wasn't the same without your attitude!
I'll have to work extra hard to motivate everyone who counts on me! I've been falling behind on that it seems!
Train with Rida too! No forget training with Rida!
Of course not!
One step closer to rebuilding the resistance back up from the ashes.
We've still got a long way to go, but we're off to a good start.
And don't forget! If you ever need anything from me, I'm back in my groove now. All you have to do is ask!
I'll be hanging out around here catching up with my girls and training with anyone who wants a tough workout!
Hey Arnold. You've been looking down ever since we got here. Like, REALLY down.
Bah...it's nothing...
You know, other people in the resistance are counting on you to be a beacon of hope for them.
I'm very much aware of that...and those expectations are proving to be a weight even I can't bear right now...
It makes me so angry!
But at the same time, I feel so powerless to do anything about it...
I didn't mean it like that. I meant that, if you feel like you're not strong enough to deal with it alone, there's no shame in asking for help.

It feels selfish. Everyone else has suffered losses just like I have, but they continue to operate...not to mention I'm sure that my losses are a little trivial in the eyes of the other resistance members...
If I were to ask for help, I'd only be putting an undue burden on the shoulders of my three colleagues...
You don't have to ask them for help. We're here to help too you know! That's actually why I wanted to talk to you.
If there's anything we can do to help get you back to your old self, we're happy to lend a hand! Isn't that right guys?
Yes. Many of us seek retribution for the acts committed against us by Peitho. This is our mutual struggle. I would lend my hand to help you if I could in any way.
Plant lady say many big words, but Rida agree with her. Rida will help too!
Do I look like the kind of gal that won't want to turn the frown of a man like you upside down?
Consider me in too. I'll do everything I can to help as well.
Wow...I...I don't know what to say...
I'm very grateful for your offer, but I'm afraid what's bothering me will probably be trivial to you guys as well. You're better off helping the others.
Come on! Don't be like that! We're the ones who offered help, weren't we?
No problem stupid.
Yeah, if it's bothering you that much, we definitely wanna help out. Whatever it is, we'll be understanding.
Well...if you guys insist...
The problem is my mannequins are gone. I figured I'd have time to take them with me during the evacuation, but I was too busy helping the other members.
I'm just not the same without them...I can barely even deadlift things I could hold up with one hand easily...
Well, it's certainly not a conventional issue.
But I think I speak for the team when I say we're still willing to help you out. Whatever it takes to get your old attitude back!
Yep, you can count on us for help!
But...why would you all risk going back into the caves to retrieve a bunch of mannequins. I recognize that to you humans they are replacable objects. There's no logical reason for you to risk it.
Doesn't really matter what most people think. Even if they look replacable to us, what matters is that they're important to you. And for that, we're willing to risk it.
We don't have to understand everything to be willing to help a friend.
Rida don't understand half of things friends do, but Rida still help!
Plus, there could be a silver lining to all this. It's quite likely that the Peitho soldiers cleaning up the base have no idea those mannequins are Arnold's most prized possession.
If they knew, there's no doubt they'd dispose of them instantly. But given what most people would think of them, there's a great chance they're still lying there in the cave untouched.
You're right! See Arnold? Things aren't so bad after all, and with us at your side, we can swoop into that cave and recover your mannequins.
Just give the word and we're ready to head out!
Well...I certainly didn't expect this...
But since you guys look so determined, I won't turn down your offer.
And I'll make sure to put in the extra effort to make up for all this sulking once we're back!
That's the spirit!
We're ready to head out then?
Seems like it!
Let the Mannequin Recovery Operation begin!
Leave.
Talk.
O-Oh! Need s-something?
Let's talk!
O-Oh! Okay.
Good talk!
Y-Yes!
Give Sofie a holiday hat!
Leave.
Talk to her.
Ya know... Maybe we could do something together.
You wanna fuck? Well you can eat my ass, but that's all you can have.
Deal.
Comfy back there, slacker~?
Oh hush up.
Ffffhaa~
Mmmm~
Fhhhhah~!
Wutcha need, slacker?
I just wanna talk.
Well make it quick! I've got important shit to do unlike yooou!
Nevermind.
Ask about what she's doing.
Ask about her life before the third crisis.
Ask her how she joined the resistance.
How was your life before all the crisis happened? Do you miss it?
Pssh... Of course not! Life is way cooler now! I couldn't have as many guns as I can now. My stash is way bigger than the zero guns I had a few years ago.
Well... Don't you miss your family and your friends?
I... Ehm...
This is my family now! Plus I've got all kinds of guns to keep me company! I don't need friends!
But... I miss cats.
Well I've seen a cat walking around Carceburg.
You're lying!
Nope! Maybe you could go see him sometime.
... That'd be nice.
So how did you end up joining the resistance?
Because someone's gotta stand up to those fucking GAG fuckers!
I asked how, not why.
Well... I was part of the Lumber Rats and ended up in some trouble... They wanted me to be one of their healsluts and I didn't really wanna...
So they kicked me out... and tossed me on the street.
But... Arnold ran into me and took me in. Since I knew my way around engineering, I could patch him up and he'd keep me safe.
Eventually him and I found out about the resistance and then we joined up!
That's a really nice story.
Yeah... it is...
But that's enough sappy shit, twinkle toes!
Wutcha workin' on over here?
Duuuh! I'm working on the generators, doofus! They're not gonna keep themselves running ya know!
Isn't that tough work? Wouldn't ya rather be working on guns or something?
Nothin's tough for me, slacker... Although more guns would always be nice. You can never have too many.
Ahh! Phew!
You stack these weights high!
We're just getting started! You're doing great though! They train you hard up in AIRSHIP?
Yep! Been a while since I did some training though.
Well you don't seem rusty at all.
Thanks!
You're welcome. Now let's get you on another machine.
Arghh!
Come on! Come on! Push! Push through it! You got it!
Phew!
Nice one! Shit, you do better than me.
Oh you're just saying that.
Nah, you're a tough gal. One of the toughest I've seen in a while.
Thanks! I try my best.
It shows! Especially in that tanktop! You look great!
Hehe, let's get you under the weights before you drown me in flattery.
